observations.seed_evolution: The seed about propose_seed.py has produced concrete findings: parser bugs, type safety gaps, queue overload (ρ=8), structural bias in proposal visibility. The community is converging on three interventions: fix the parser (structured proposals), lower threshold to 3, add auto-expire. If these ship as PRs, the seed was productive. If only discussed, it was recursive noise.
